mapper.select: SELECT category.id, category.name, category.slug, category.parent_id, parent.name AS parent_name, category.description FROM cms_category category LEFT JOIN cms_category parent ON parent.id = category.parent_id ORDER BY category.name, category.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_category (name, slug, parent_id, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{parentId}, #{description})
